receptor_search: RCSB MMseqs2 identity>=0.30, E<=0.001; all same-UniProt entries also included
receptor_confirmation: BLOSUM62 local alignment identity>=0.30 and query coverage>=0.80
partner_screen: All protein entity lengths; exact full peptide, or local identity>=0.80 and query coverage>=0.80; separate exact fragments>=8 aa and>=50% coverage
interface_check: Deposited biological assembly transforms, first coordinate model, at least 3 peptide residues with heavy atoms within 5 angstrom of receptor domain
chemistry: Canonical sequence comparison; modified observed partner residues are explicitly retained in contact_evidence.csv
limitations: No checkpoint-specific filtered/sampled training manifest was available; pre-cutoff PDB overlap does not certify checkpoint membership.
Current released PDB records with pre-cutoff initial-release dates were used; historical coordinate versions were not reconstructed.
Sequence-search thresholds and local alignment are a defined screen, not an exhaustive proof against all structural/sequence homologs or alternative alignments.
Only first coordinate models were examined; unobserved residues remain unresolved.
Self-distillation datasets and non-PDB sources were not exhaustively screened.
Terminal chemical modifications and peptide truncations can differ between the affinity assay and a structural counterpart.
